items.en: Should you require further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
items.fr: Au cas où vous auriez besoin de plus d'information, veuillez ne pas hésiter à me contacter.
items.after: require further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.

items.en: Should you run into trouble, I'll help, and so will my father.
items.fr: Devriez-vous encourir des ennuis, je vous aiderai, et mon père aussi.
items.after: run into trouble, I'll help, and so will my father.

items.en: Should it rain tomorrow, the baseball game will be postponed.
items.fr: S'il venait à pleuvoir demain, la partie de baseball serait reportée.
items.after: rain tomorrow, the baseball game will be postponed.

items.en: Should I fail, I would try again.
Were it not for water, nothing could live.
items.fr: Si ce n'était grâce à l'eau, rien ne pourrait vivre.
items.after: not for water, nothing could live.

items.en: Had I known your telephone number, I would have called you.
items.fr: Si j'avais su votre numéro de téléphone, je vous aurai appelé.
items.after: known your telephone number, I would have called you.
